build_moolib_package: build the moolib package using pip install with CMake-based C++ extension compilation
build_moolib_debug: build the moolib package in debug mode using python setup.py build --debug install
build_moolib_no_cuda: build the moolib package without CUDA support by setting USE_CUDA environment variable to OFF
review_CMakeBuild_class: review the CMakeBuild class that extends build_ext to configure and run CMake for C++ extensions
review_main_function: review the main function that configures setuptools.setup with package metadata and the CMakeBuild command class
